name: SurveyMonkey
description: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover trends in SurveyMonkey—right from Claude. Turn feedback into clear next steps without leaving your workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SurveyMonkey to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SurveyMonkey to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.surveymonkey.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SurveyMonkey MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SurveyMonkey lists 20 MCP tools, including add_page, add_question, create_survey, create_weblink_collector, delete_question, edit_question, generate_survey_plan, get_page, get_pages, get_question, get_question_types, and get_questions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SurveyMonkey?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SurveyMonkey in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SurveyMonkey requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SurveyMonkey is developed by SurveyMonkey. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
